d: After 13 years of anticipation, GTA 6 has finally arrived, and an unexpected Indian track is winning fans over. Rupa Biswas’s 1982 Bengali-Hindi disco number ‘Aaj Shanibar’ features on one of the game’s in-car radio stations. Its inclusion has sparked excitement among Indian fans, introducing the retro disco hit to a new generation of gamers worldwide. A decades-old Indian song has found an unlikely global spotlight, turning a nostalgic favourite into a talking point among GTA 6 players.
